subject: eng
title: Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.explain: tidy 以「輔音 d + y」結尾，第三人稱單數 Holly 後面改 y 為 ies（tidies）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Holly ___ her room every day.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.q: He ___ songs and ___ with his friends every morning.
questions.explain: play 以「元音 a + y」結尾，直接加 -s（plays，不可寫 plaies）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: He ___ songs and ___ with his friends every morning.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.q: ___ your father walk the dog every day? Yes, he does.
questions.explain: 主語 your father 是第三人稱單數，一般現在時疑問句用助動詞 Does。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ your father walk the dog every day? Yes, he does.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.q: Betty is lazy. She ___ study for her tests.
questions.explain: 第三人稱單數 She 的否定句用 does not（doesn't）+ 原形動詞 study。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Betty is lazy. She ___ study for her tests.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.explain: 助動詞 does not / doesn't 後面的動詞必須還原為原形 eat。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Kitty does not ___ fish.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.q: Fill in the simple present form: Mr Bell ___ (watch) TV every night.
questions.explain: watch 以 ch 結尾，第三人稱單數加 -es（watches）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the simple present form: Mr Bell ___ (watch) TV every night.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.q: For verbs ending in vowel + y (like 'play', 'enjoy', 'buy'), we add '-s' instead of '-ies' for he/she/it.
questions.explain: 元音 + y 結尾的動詞（plays, enjoys, buys）直接加 -s。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: For verbs ending in vowel + y (like 'play', 'enjoy', 'buy'), we add '-s' instead of '-ies' for he/she/it.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2B Ch 1–2: Simple Present Tense (Habits, Spelling & Negatives)

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a negative sentence.
questions.explain: 第三人稱單數否定句：Gary does not tidy his room every day.
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Rearrange the words to form a negative sentence.
